title: Watanabe-Strogatz Invariants in the Liouvillian Dynamics of Coupled Phase Oscillators via the Koopman Framework
summary: In dynamical systems, invariants, i.e., constants of motion conserved along the trajectory, play important roles in characterizing the system's dynamical behavior. Recent applications of the Koopman operator framework to nonlinear dynamical systems have provided new insights into the invariants. For a certain class of globally coupled phase oscillators, which serve as models for various synchronization phenomena, Watanabe and Strogatz proved the existence of N-3 invariants in N oscillator systems.
